while True:
    state = ledger.reconstruct_current_state()
    incidents = integrity_checks(state)
    if incidents.has_global_authority_risk():
        pause_canonical_commits()
        emit_incident(incidents)
        continue

    reap_or_recover_expired_leases()
    collect_completed_workers()
    enqueue_validation()
    validate_and_commit_with_compare_and_swap()

    for pool in worker_pools:
        while pool.has_capacity():
            capsule = scheduler.next_eligible_capsule(
                pool=pool,
                certification_required=True,
                independence_aware=True,
                budget_aware=True,
            )
            if capsule is None:
                break
            lease = issue_lease(capsule, pool)
            provider_adapter.launch(capsule, lease)

    checkpoint_scheduler_metrics()
    sleep(poll_interval)
